name: TakeZeroedPoolEntry
evidence: takes an entry from pool D_0025C2D0 with TakePoolEntry and clears its 12 bytes

name: CopyScriptValueChain
evidence: deep-copies a value with CloneValue, then recurses over the next pointer, making a new node for each

name: NewScriptValueNode
evidence: takes a 0xC-byte node from the pool D_0025C250, clears it and sets its value to unset (tag -1)

name: DestroyScriptValueNode
evidence: the node pool's removeCallback: destroys the node's value with DestroyValue (flags 2)

name: CopyScriptValueRecord
evidence: copies the five words of a tag 0x1F record, using a given first word unless it is 0

name: NewScriptValueRecord
evidence: takes a 0x14-byte record from the pool D_0025C2B0 and clears it

name: InitScriptValue
evidence: constructor: sets the tag to -1 and returns the value

name: CopyConstructScriptValue
evidence: copy constructor: takes a reference on the source's payload, then copies tag and word

name: DestroyScriptValue
evidence: destructor: releases the payload and, when bit 0 of the flags is set, deletes the value with func_0018D778

name: AssignScriptValue
evidence: assignment: references the source's payload, releases the old one and copies tag and word

name: AreScriptValuesEqual
evidence: 0 when the tags differ; then compares by tag: float equality (0x15), bytes (0x17), 2 or 3 floats (0x19, 0x16/0x18/0x1A), booleans (0x1B), words for the integer and pointer tags

name: CloneScriptValue
evidence: copies the tag and, per tag, makes a fresh node chain (0x1E), a fresh pooled payload (0x16..0x1A) or a fresh record (0x1F), else copies the word

name: ReleaseScriptValuePayload
evidence: for tags 0x16..0x1A calls the matching Release...Payload on the word

name: AddRefScriptValuePayload
evidence: for tags 0x16..0x1A calls the matching AddRef...Payload on the word

name: SetScriptValueTag
evidence: releases the payload and sets only the tag (BD28 uses it to make the empty result, 0x22)

name: SetScriptValueInt
evidence: releases the payload, stores the integer and sets tag 0x14

name: SetScriptValueFloat
evidence: releases the payload, stores the float and sets tag 0x15

name: SetScriptValueBool
evidence: releases the payload, stores 1 or 0 from the flag and sets tag 0x1B

name: SetScriptValuePointer
evidence: releases the payload, stores the pointer and sets tag 0x1C

name: SetScriptValueIntB
evidence: releases the payload, stores the integer and sets tag 0x1D (the stream reader's case 29)

name: SetScriptValueChain
evidence: releases the payload, stores the first node and sets tag 0x1E

name: SetScriptValueRecord
evidence: releases the payload, stores a tag 0x1F record and sets tag 0x1F

name: SetScriptValueVectorA
evidence: references the pooled block, releases the old payload, stores it and sets tag 0x16

name: SetScriptValueMatrix
evidence: references the pooled block, releases the old payload, stores it and sets tag 0x17

name: SetScriptValueVectorB
evidence: references the pooled block, releases the old payload, stores it and sets tag 0x18

name: SetScriptValuePair
evidence: references the pooled block, releases the old payload, stores it and sets tag 0x19

name: SetScriptValueTriple
evidence: references the pooled block, releases the old payload, stores it and sets tag 0x1A

name: SetScriptValuePointerB
evidence: releases the payload, stores the pointer and sets tag 0x20 (the stream reader's case 32)

name: SetScriptValueIntC
evidence: releases the payload, stores the integer and sets tag 0x21

name: ConvertScriptValueToInt
evidence: gives back a copy when the tag is already 0x14, otherwise a tag 0x14 value holding the float truncated to an integer

name: ConvertScriptValueToFloat
evidence: gives back a copy when the tag is already 0x15, otherwise a tag 0x15 value holding the integer converted to float

name: ReadScriptValueChain
evidence: reads a tag byte from the stream (0xFF ends, bit 7 means another node follows), reads the payload that tag needs into a new node (integers, floats, pooled vectors, a nested chain) and links the next node

name: AddKeyedValue
evidence: makes a keyed node holding a copy of the value and pushes it at the head of the list without looking for the key; gives back an empty (0x22) value

name: UpdateKeyedValue
evidence: walks the list for the key and assigns the value to the node found; gives back an empty (0x22) value either way

name: FindKeyedValue
evidence: walks the list for the key and, when found, copies its value to the out value (if given) and returns 1, else 0

name: CopyKeyedList
evidence: makes a keyed node, copies the list into it with CopyKeyedValueChain and stores it as the head of the out list

name: NewKeyedList
evidence: allocates the 4-byte list head with func_0018D5C0 and clears it

name: InitScriptValuePools
evidence: sets up the five pools D_0025C250..D_0025C2D0 with InitEntryPool and installs the removeCallbacks of the node, scope and keyed pools

name: ShutDownScriptValuePools
evidence: calls the pools' teardown func_0011C1D0 for each, func_0011CBB0 and func_0011A6B8 (mirror of InitValuePools)
